profile_text.body:
Khan Academy is a nonprofit organization that operates an online educational platform accessible at khanacademy.org. The site's harvested text returned only a client challenge response rather than substantive content, so details about the breadth of its curriculum or specific programs come exclusively from the held facts rather than the site's own pages.

Khan Academy offers an AI-powered educational product called Khanmigo, categorized as an education and research AI tool. The held facts note that Khanmigo functions as an educational AI tutor and flag several associated considerations, including student interaction data practices, COPPA compliance, and pedagogical bias. No litigation, MCP server registration, SEC filings, or patent records are held for Khan Academy in the current dataset.
